# The Index Folio

One folio indexing every working site by Chris Dillinger, at https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/.
Each entry states, in a single line, why the site deserves a visit, with the evidence beside the claim.
The page is written in full in the Notebook design language (https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/notebook/):
material grammar (underdrawing, working, committed ink), composition grammar (adjacency, direct keying,
evidence margins, small multiples), and the information flow answer, evidence, revision, source.

## Sites

- Portfolio (https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/portfolio/): first-principles RISC-V, C, and OS kernel work.
  Every claim backed by a runnable demo. Visit to vet the work and to hire Chris for board, firmware, or kernel problems.
- Proving Ground (https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/proving-ground/): 70 interactive benches, one mechanism each,
  taught why-first. Visit to build engineering intuition you can check by hand.
- Notebook (https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/notebook/): the complete design language this index is written in,
  sourced to Leonardo, Tufte, and Distill. Visit to learn the method.
- GHOSTLIGHT (https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/ghostlight/): red-team walkthroughs of MITRE ATT&CK TA0005 stealth
  techniques, each with a red demo and a blue demo. Visit to learn attack and detection together.
- Wigmore (https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/wigmore/): an evidence-chart playground for laying out arguments as
  claims, support, and doubt, shareable by link. Visit to reason in public.
- OLD IRON (https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/old-iron/): retirement for servers and GPUs. Free pickup, certified
  NIST 800-88 data wiping, insured logistics. Visit when hardware is done earning.
- TAPEOUT (https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/tapeout/): lean compute-hardware distribution. Quoted parts, burn-in
  tested, honest R&D log. Visit to buy parts without theater.
- UNSTUCK (https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/unstuck/): computer help in plain words, one visit at a time.
  Visit when the machine wins.
- Signs (https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/signs/): an experiment classifying text into Peirce's ten sign classes.
  Visit to watch the machine read.
- Cigarettes (https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/cigarettes/): a brand ledger comparing 53 cigarette brands across
  19 factors, tar, nicotine, and CO machine yields, product design, smoke chemistry, smoking behavior, and human biology.
  Measurements are kept strictly separate from human dose. Visit to compare brands on evidence, not vibes.
